set.body:
Objective:
Complete the focused analytical relational surface needed for a useful 0.1 local workflow on the independent reference interpreter, while preserving the small canonical IR and typed/runtime schema coherence laws.

0.1 scope:
- Hash group-by with count, sum, mean, variance, minimum, and maximum plus explicit empty/null policies.
- Inner and left joins with exact key typing, SQL null-key semantics, deterministic collision handling, and correct right-side nullability after a left join.
- Stable explicit sort with declared null placement and order guarantees.
- Limit with streaming early termination.
- Batch-aware execution that streams when possible and declares buffering or whole-input requirements when not.

Deferred:
Right and full outer joins, Union, Distinct, Window operations, user-defined aggregate functions, arbitrary row closures, spill, distributed execution, and a pandas-size convenience catalog. The typed API spike may still prove general outer-join nullability rules before all physical variants are implemented.

Acceptance:
- Dynamic and typed APIs construct the same plans and runtime output schemas for every supported operator.
- Independent scalar-loop oracles establish grouped aggregate and join correctness across nulls, NaNs, duplicate keys, empty inputs, multiple chunks, and collision cases.
- Left joins lift right-field nullability in both runtime schema and named-tuple result type.
- Using-key joins coalesce only requested equijoin keys; general on joins retain qualified scopes until explicit projection.
- JVM and Scala.js suites pass with deterministic receipts and compile-negative schema tests.
- No operator requires Gale, DuckDB, Polars, Spark, ScalaFIM domain types, or row-object materialization.
set.title: Frame foundation 4: group/aggregate, inner and left join, sort, and limit
